results.title: Bessent’s bond market push struggles to bring down US borrowing costs
results.description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessents bond-buyback push has offered only limited relief, with long-term Treasury yields rising again. Investors remain focused on the wider pressures driving borrowing costs higher, including the growing fiscal deficit, heavy government debt issuance, persistent inflation and uncertainty over Federal Reserve policy.
